summary_markdown:
The participants discussed an external task/ticket detailing a specific API request. They struggled to identify the source of the reported data, noting that it did not match existing internal APIs like `/report/frames`. One participant suggested requesting clarification from the original poster regarding the nature of the files and how the API is being called.

Later, one participant shared an example Python script demonstrating a POST request to `https://data-api.allunite.com/report/demographics/short` for demographic data between May 1st and May 31st, with hourly granularity. This structure was recognized by the other participant as relating to a previously encountered calculation matrix issue.
decisions: Request clarification from the original poster regarding the external API usage and file types.
action_items: Follow up on the demographic data reporting issue using the provided API example.
